title: Chai-2 reports 16% hit rate in zero-shot de novo antibody design
summary: Designing at most 20 antibodies or nanobodies per target for 52 targets without prior PDB binders gave at least one hit for 50% of targets in a single round; 68% wet-lab success for miniproteins. Preprint; the abstract is the only material reviewed; independent replication and developability are not shown; some strengths come from the company's own assays.
